source_refs.note: 3. Relative Speed: a main subheading of 10.8 Factors affecting emf, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 243-243.

blocks.text: Magnetic field mein coil (ya conductor) ki speed bhi induced emf ki amount (kitna) par asar karti hai. Tez speed se flux ki change ki rate barhti hai, aur is se induced emf barh jati hai.

blocks.caption: Induced emf par asar karne wale factors
rows: Coil aur magnet ki relative speed

blocks.prompt: 0.2 T field mein chalti metal rod ke siron par 0.8 V emf hai; baqi sab wahi rakh kar 2.4 V ke liye kitni field chahiye (numerical 10.4)? 4.0 cm radius aur 1.0 milliohm resistance wala copper chhalla perpendicular field mein hai jo 5 × 10⁻³ s mein 0.2 T se 0.4 T ho jati hai; current nikalein (numerical 10.5).
Faraday ka law aur Lenz ka law bayan aur clear kijiye, aur induced emf par asar karne wale factors bataiye (comprehensive question 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Faraday ka law: N loops wali coil mein induced average (darmiyani value) emf us se magnetic flux ki change ki rate ke negative ke barabar hai, ε = −NΔϕ/Δt. Lenz ka law: induced current hamesha us change ko oppose karta hai jis ne use paida kiya; isi liye minus ki sign (nishan) hai aur isi liye electrical energy banane ke liye work karna parta hai. Emf flux ki change ki rate, turns ki number aur coil aur magnet ki relative speed ke saath barhti hai.

items: Induced emf barhti hai (1) flux ki change ki rate, (2) turns ki number (proportional) aur (3) field mein coil ya conductor ki relative speed ke saath.
